model_window.note: Casey, Nov 9 (D-2225): from the weekly reset every worker, reviewer and the runner's session run on this model instead of the plan's, and the pacer runs to the real usage limit; kit/tasks.json is unchanged. With end_on_limit the window closes by itself at the first usage limit inside it (kit-state `model_window_ended`), and the build is back on the plan's models and normal pacing. `until` (an ISO UTC time, set in a reviewed PR) also ends it; outside [from, until) nothing changes. runner/model_window.py reads it.

order_note: Casey, Nov 10 (D-2591): use this week's tokens to move the build as far as possible. After a resync and claim_first, claimable tasks are tried longest remaining dependency chain first (open dependents, the task counted, gates included), kit-state order breaking ties; ordering only. Remove this key (or set "state") to go back to kit-state order. runner/__main__.py claim_order_setting and runner/cycle.py chain_lengths read it.
prefer_disjoint_crates_note: D-3082 (Nov 11, efficiency audit F2): two tasks in one app/ crate both update its CLAUDE.md, and the second to merge needs a resync (D-891). With this true, among claimable tasks of equal priority (after a resync, claim_first and the critical-path chain length) one whose app/ crates no task in flight shares is tried first; ordering only, so when every candidate shares a crate the claim is made as before and every lane still fills. Set false (or remove the key) to go back to the old order. runner/__main__.py prefer_disjoint_crates and runner/lanes.py crowded read it.
smoke_ancestry_reuse_note: D-3058 (Nov 11; Casey delegated the call to Fable), D-3156 (Nov 12, raised from 3 to 5): the start routine's smoke may stand on the last real green smoke of an ancestor of main's head up to this many first-parent commits back, when every commit since, the head included, is a DONE task's recorded squash merge or (D-3156) a merge whose one merged PR has a head with the identical tree and every Ci, Twin and Ally run green on it, and nothing doubts any of them (no red or timed-out smoke, no D-498 strike, no main_red_history entry, no red nightly, Ci/Twin/Ally not red); never while main is red, and clearing a red main still needs a fresh green. The base is a real run at most 6 hours old, so a real smoke runs at least every N+1 merges. 0 turns it off. runner/__main__.py smoke_ancestry and runner/cycle.py _ancestry_reuse read it.
